component.name: USBooty
component.summary: Create bootable USB drives from ISO images

description.p: USBooty turns an ISO image into a bootable USB drive. It can write a raw "DD" image, partition and copy an installer (FAT32, NTFS, exFAT or ext4 — including the Windows UEFI:NTFS layout), set up Linux live-USB persistence, customize a Windows 11 install, format a drive, and create a Ventoy multi-boot USB.
